description: This file defines a Java interface 'DoubleArray' which provides a standard way to interact with different implementations of double arrays. It includes methods for accessing, modifying, and managing elements of double arrays, supporting features like dynamic resizing and rolling additions.

classes.name: DoubleArray
classes.description: A Java interface for manipulating arrays of doubles with support for dynamic resizing, element access, and rolling additions.

methods.name: getNumElements
methods.description: Returns the number of elements currently stored in the array, which may differ from the internal storage length.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Fetches the element at a specified index, throwing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException if out of bounds.

methods.name: setElement
methods.description: Sets the value at a specified index, increasing the number of elements if necessary.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the expandable array.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the end of the array.

methods.name: addElementRolling
methods.description: Adds an element to the end while removing the first element, returning the discarded element.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns a copy of all elements in the array as a double[].

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the array, removing all elements.
